notes: Direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (Shopify store, no WAF, per prior pass). Checked top-level nav (New In, Cooking & Dining, Baking, Cleaning, Laundry, Storage & Home, Electricals, Offers) via rendered homepage HTML - no Bestsellers/Best Sellers/Top Sellers/Popular/Trending/Customer Favourites entry point. Probed candidate URL shapes directly against Shopify's /collections/<handle>/products.json: best-sellers, bestsellers, best-selling, top-sellers, popular, customer-favorites - all returned HTTP 200 (Shopify's soft-404 behaviour for a themed collection page) but 0 products in every case, i.e. no real handle exists. To rule out a false absence from guessed slugs, fetched the site's full sitemap_collections_1.xml (603 collection URLs) and scanned every handle for best/top-sell/top-rated/popular/favourite/favorite/trend/loved/most-loved/editor/recommend/staff-pick/fan-fave/must-have - zero matches. Also checked Shopify's native /search/suggest.json (returned empty; site actually uses an Algolia instantsearch app for on-site search per the collection page markup, not Shopify's native search, so this endpoint is not a reliable absence signal on its own, hence the full sitemap enumeration as the primary proof). Footer nav has no outlet/bestseller link either. Conclusion: Lakeland exposes no genuine bestseller/most-popular merchandising PLP; individual PDPs may carry review-based star ratings but no page presents a curated 'bestsellers' listing.
